document_contents.quote: The impugned proceedings, during this period, proceeded on the erroneous premise that, (i) petitioner has not paid GST on reverse charge basis on transportation services and, (ii) non- reversal of ITC awaited on services attributable to exempt services.

defects_argued.quote: With the above liberty, and for the reasons set out in Milroc Good Earth Developers (supra) and Rite Water Solutions (India) Ltd. (supra), the petition is partly allowed.
